hero.trustNote: Educational routing is not financing approval, a binding offer or a guarantee.

sections.headline: BUILD IT. FUND IT. OWN MORE.
sections.copy: Capital, intelligence and infrastructure for the next move. This is where business owners, deal buyers and funding professionals find the right lane without starting with a lender’s product list.

sections.headline: WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO MAKE HAPPEN?
sections.copy: Choose FUND, BUILD, BUY, OPERATE or OFFER. Update the next-step card and route recommendations immediately. These are editorial pathways, not underwriting or financial offers.

sections.headline: PICK THE MISSION. WE’LL SHOW THE ROUTE.
sections.copy: Money for the business, cash-flow repairs, stronger credit, an acquisition, useful technology or a distribution opportunity: different moves, different specialists.

sections.headline: ONE FLAGSHIP. SPECIALISTS FOR THE REST.
sections.copy: Funding owns products; Solutions owns operating outcomes; Industries owns vertical context; Acquire owns transactions. Tools and Marketplace add useful functionality as their destinations go live.

sections.headline: GOOD CAPITAL HAS A JOB TO DO.
sections.copy: Working capital, lines of credit, equipment, acquisition or property financing may be relevant for different purposes. Compare options through the dedicated Funding property.

sections.headline: START WITH THE QUESTION, NOT THE APPLICATION.
sections.copy: Name the goal. Confirm the facts. Compare routes. Test the economics. Take the action that actually advances the business.

sections.headline: RUN THE NUMBERS BEFORE THEY RUN YOU.
sections.copy: Surface verified calculators and assessments with their assumptions and limits. Do not claim readiness scores, offer eligibility or live finance data that the site has not calculated.

sections.headline: DIFFERENT BUSINESSES. DIFFERENT CASH CYCLES.
sections.copy: From contractors waiting on progress payments to ecommerce merchants paying for inventory, the industry changes the problem. Find the operating model that matches yours.

sections.headline: THE ASKING PRICE IS NOT THE WHOLE DEAL.
sections.copy: Understand valuation assumptions, diligence questions, capital structures and what happens after closing. Continue into the Acquire platform for the full workflow.

sections.headline: BETTER SYSTEMS. FEWER RANDOM SUBSCRIPTIONS.
sections.copy: Accounting, banking, CRM, marketing and payments providers should earn a place in your workflow. The marketplace is planned; use the existing services destination in the meantime.

sections.headline: WHAT IF YOU WERE THE PERSON BUSINESSES CALLED?
sections.copy: Business owners already ask trusted professionals where to find capital. Explore referral, professional partner and agency opportunities without implying guaranteed earnings.

sections.headline: LEARN THE GAME BEFORE THE GAME CHARGES TUITION.
sections.copy: Feature the best existing articles, guides and explainers. The Wix blog retains the original publication URLs, dates and editorial ownership.

sections.headline: THE CONTENT AND COMMUNITY DON’T DISAPPEAR.
sections.copy: Blog, events, courses, groups, member services and bookings remain owned by Wix or their actual current systems until the cutover has a verified continuity plan.

sections.headline: WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO BUILD?
sections.copy: Get funding, strengthen the business, buy one or help other operators access capital. Choose the route that matches the job.
